\begin{document}
Let $x$ be real. We use the elementary results
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\,\tan^{-1} x}{dx} = \frac{1}{1+x^2}
\label{eq:a1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\tan\left(\tan^{-1} x\right) = x
\label{eq:a3}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\,\sinh^{-1} x}{dx} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}
\label{eq:a4}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\sinh\left(\sinh^{-1} x\right) = x
\label{eq:a5}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
